_comment: Player settings, in menu order. kind: bool (on / off), choice (one of options), range (whole numbers min..max in steps, shown with an optional unit). A new setting only needs an entry here and someone who reads Game.settings.
_volume: Volumes: range entries with a bus are read by the Sfx autoload (Sfx.set_volume(bus, value / max)); the menu draws them as sliders.
